hints.title: Counting Followers per User
hints.text: Count the number of followers for each user.

hints.title: Grouping by User ID
hints.text: group the followers table by user_id.

hints.title: Sorting in Ascending Order
hints.text: count follower_id per user and order the result by user_id in ascending order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT user_id, COUNT(follower_id) AS followers_count
FROM Followers
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY user_id;
```

complexity.notes: Group by user_id aggregates counts and sorts users in ascending order.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting rows without grouping produces a single aggregate total across all users instead of per user.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Group by with sorting runs in O(N log K) time where K is the number of distinct users.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly write GROUP BY and ORDER BY query on indexed columns.
